channel.title: David Braun: Articles
channel.description: Articles by David Braun on robotics research: dynamics, optimal control, and mechanically adaptive machines.

item.title: Bridging science and vision: From the lab to real-world robotics
item.description: How fundamental research in dynamics and optimization becomes real-world robotics: the path from scientific discovery to machines people use.

item.title: The science behind robot boots
item.description: Spring-driven robot boots could let runners supply energy in the air, not only on the ground. A Science Advances study predicts running 50% faster.

item.title: Mechanically adaptive robotics: NSF CAREER Award
item.description: NSF CAREER Award research on programmable springs: robots and wearable devices that adapt their mechanics to do more with the same energy.

item.title: Optimal control by experiment: NSF Grant
item.description: Optimal control by experiment closes the sim-to-real gap: robots improve their motion on the real machine, half model-based and half data-driven.

item.title: Optimal control of compliant robots: IEEE T-RO Best Paper Award
item.description: Optimal control of compliant robots under physical limits; 2013 King-Sun Fu Memorial IEEE Transactions on Robotics Best Paper Award.
